description: This Python source file defines a base class for strategies that determine when a user starts speaking in a dialogue system, including event handling and parameter definitions related to user turn start detection.

classes.name: UserTurnStartedParams
classes.description: Data class that encapsulates parameters emitted when the user turn starts, including flags for enabling interruptions and user speaking frames.

classes.name: BaseUserTurnStartStrategy
classes.description: An abstract base class for defining strategies that detect the start of a user's turn based on incoming data frames, with mechanisms to trigger events such as frame pushing, broadcasting, and signaling turn start.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, enable_interruptions: bool = True, enable_user_speaking_frames: bool = True, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the strategy with options for interruptions and speaking frames, and sets up event handlers.

methods.description: Property that returns the configured task manager or raises an error if not set.

methods.name: setup(self, task_manager: BaseTaskManager)
methods.description: Associates a task manager with this strategy instance asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Performs cleanup operations for the strategy asynchronously.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the state of the strategy asynchronously.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame to decide if a user turn has started; meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Emits an event to push a frame downstream or upstream depending on the direction.

methods.name: broadcast_frame(self, frame_cls: Type[Frame], **kwargs)
methods.description: Broadcasts a frame of a specified class with optional parameters.

methods.name: trigger_user_turn_started(self)
methods.description: Triggers the event indicating that the user has started speaking, passing relevant parameters.
